# Zen Browser

> Zen is a beautiful, fast, and productive web browser. Zen is built on the latest Firefox engine, providing speed, privacy, and security while offering our unique features and experience.

Zen is free and open-source software for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It does not collect telemetry or personal data.

## Get started

- [Download Zen](https://zen-browser.app/download): Installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux (including Flathub).
- [Documentation](https://docs.zen-browser.app/): Guides and the user manual.
- [Zen Mods](https://zen-browser.app/mods): Community-made themes and plugins for Zen.

## Project information

- [Release notes](https://zen-browser.app/release-notes): Changelog for every stable version.
- [Release notes feed (RSS)](https://zen-browser.app/feed.xml): Subscribe to new releases.
- [About Zen](https://zen-browser.app/about): The team and contributors.
- [Privacy policy](https://zen-browser.app/privacy-policy): What Zen does and does not collect.
- [Donate](https://zen-browser.app/donate): Support development through Patreon or Ko-fi.

## Source code and support

- [Browser source code](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop): The Zen Browser repository (MPL-2.0).
- [Website source code](https://github.com/zen-browser/www): This website.
- [Report an issue](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/new/choose)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/security/policy)
